idea-plugin.name: LoreMaster
idea-plugin.description:
LoreMaster gathers a project's lore. This first preview brings its Markdown export to JetBrains IDEs.

  • Export a Markdown file to HTML, Word (.docx), OpenDocument (.odt), PDF, PNG, plain text, Jira wiki, Jira Cloud JSON and MediaWiki.
  • From the editor, the project view or the Tools menu: LoreMaster: Export Markdown As...
  • PDF and PNG need Chrome, Edge or Chromium installed; the other formats need nothing.

Everything runs in the bundled lore-master-engine; nothing is sent anywhere. Syncing to Confluence and GitHub Pages is coming.

action.description: Start the LoreMaster engine and check that it answers
Export this Markdown file to HTML, Word, OpenDocument, PDF, PNG, plain text, Jira or MediaWiki
